note: Common developer USB ids. VID/PID are lowercase hex; pid '*' is vendor-wide. Exact pid beats vendor wildcard.

entries.name: Espressif USB-Serial/JTAG (built-in)
entries.notes: Native USB-Serial-JTAG peripheral on ESP32-S3/C3/C6/H2. Flash and debug over one cable; no external bridge chip.

entries.name: Espressif ESP32-S2 native USB (ROM bootloader)
entries.notes: ESP32-S2 in ROM download mode or running a native USB CDC app.

entries.name: Espressif native USB device
entries.notes: Any Espressif-vendor device (ESP32-S2/S3/C3/C6 native USB, TinyUSB apps).

entries.name: Silicon Labs CP210x USB-UART bridge
entries.notes: CP2102/CP2104 family. Port appears as cu.SLAB_USBtoUART or /dev/ttyUSB*.

entries.name: WCH CH340 USB-UART bridge
entries.notes: Common on clone ESP32/Arduino boards. Port appears as cu.wchusbserial* or /dev/ttyUSB*.

entries.name: WCH CH9102 USB-UART bridge
entries.notes: Common on newer ESP32 dev boards.

entries.name: FTDI FT2232 dual USB-UART/JTAG
entries.notes: Also the ESP-Prog JTAG/UART board.

entries.name: Prolific PL2303 USB-UART
entries.notes: Counterfeit PL2303 chips are rejected by recent Windows drivers.

entries.name: Raspberry Pi RP2040 BOOTSEL (UF2 bootloader)
entries.notes: Mass-storage boot mode; drag a .uf2 onto the RPI-RP2 drive.

entries.name: Raspberry Pi RP2350 BOOTSEL (UF2 bootloader)
entries.notes: Mass-storage boot mode on RP2350.

entries.name: Raspberry Pi Pico (SDK CDC serial)
entries.notes: Pico running firmware that exposes the SDK USB serial port.

entries.name: MicroPython RP2 board
entries.notes: Raspberry Pi RP2-family board running MicroPython (USB CDC REPL).

entries.name: STMicroelectronics Virtual COM Port
entries.notes: STM32 running a CDC firmware.

entries.name: STMicroelectronics STM32 DFU bootloader
entries.notes: STM32 ROM DFU mode; flash with dfu-util.

entries.name: ST-LINK/V3 (no mass storage)
entries.notes: Seen on STM32 Nucleo boards (for example the NUCLEO-N657X0-Q).

entries.name: Adafruit board
entries.notes: Adafruit-vendor USB device (Feather/ItsyBitsy/QT Py family running CircuitPython or UF2).

entries.name: Seeed Studio board
entries.notes: Seeed XIAO and related boards.

entries.name: Nordic Semiconductor device
entries.notes: nRF dev kit, dongle, or bootloader.

entries.name: CMSIS-DAP / DAPLink debug probe
entries.notes: Also the on-board probe of many micro:bit and ARM dev boards.

entries.name: Realtek RTL2838 DVB-T / RTL-SDR
entries.notes: Generic RTL-SDR dongle.

entries.name: Ettus USRP B200/B210
entries.notes: Firmware-loaded state.

entries.name: Coral USB Accelerator (unprogrammed)
entries.notes: Global Unichip ID before the runtime loads firmware; re-enumerates as 18d1:9302.

entries.name: Luxonis OAK / Intel Movidius MyriadX (boot)
entries.notes: Device in boot mode, before the DepthAI pipeline loads.

entries.name: Teensy HalfKay bootloader
entries.notes: Press the program button; flash with teensy_loader_cli.
